thread:
mira: quick heads-up — ran a lightweight GPTQ bake across Llama-2-13B, Mistral-7B, and Qwen-7B this morning. sharing top-line deltas and ops notes.

sam: nice — which quant configs did you compare?

mira: compared GPTQ 4-bit (per-channel, act-order) vs AWQ 4-bit-hybrid vs an int8-llm run for baseline cost/latency. fp16 reference for accuracy.

devin: any benchmark suite or just spot checks?

mira: small sweep: MMLU, Lambada (ppl), Winogrande small, and several in-house safety prompts. short summary:
- MMLU accuracy delta vs fp16: llama-2-13b (gptq-4): -2.3%, mistral-7b (gptq-4): -1.1%, qwen-7b (gptq-4): -3.8%.
- LAMBADA ppl delta: llama +6%, mistral +2%, qwen +10%.
- AWQ (qwen awq-4-hybrid) recovered ~1.5% of qwen MMLU gap but increased decode latency by ~8ms/token.

alexa: interesting that Mistral holds up so well — was seq-len short?

mira: tests mostly 128-512 tokens. longer runs (2k) show qwen GPTQ has KV-cache degradation — extra stall after ~800 tokens.

ryan: ops questions — were kernels fused / custom CUDA used?

mira: used our gptq compile flags + fused-kv where available. AWQ build used the new kernel path (experimental). perf numbers:
- Mistral-7B (gptq-4): 26 ms/1token @ bs=1 seq=512 (p50).
- Llama-13B (gptq-4): 48 ms/token @ bs=1 seq=512.
- Qwen-7B (gptq-4): 30 ms/token but KV stalls on longctx.
- Qwen (awq-4-hybrid): 38 ms/token (higher) but better accuracy.

sam: any memory wins? model size reduction vs fp16?

mira: yes, gptq-4 drops memory ~2.8x vs fp16 for Llama, AWQ similar for Qwen but CPU-side buffer increase ~+200MB due to hybrid structures.

devin: did you run any small instruction-tuning evals? hallucination / factuality checks?

mira: quick safety pass — hallucination measured by our err-rate probe: Qwen GPTQ up +0.6% err, AWQ brought it back down near baseline. Mistral nearly baseline.

alexa: any model-specific quirks to call out for deployment profiles?

mira: yes — notes: 
- Llama-2-13B: reliable across metrics, best fit for throughput-focused Dedicated pools. recommend profile: reserved_gpus=2, batch_target=8, max_seq=1024, kv_cache_prefetch=true.
- Mistral-7B: lowest accuracy degradation and best latency/throughput mix. good candidate for latency SLA tiers and small burst pools.
- Qwen-7B: higher accuracy drop with GPTQ; if accuracy-sensitive, prefer AWQ-4-hybrid or fall back to fp16 for long-context customers. enable longctx kernel tuning.

ryan: ops: anything to add to rollout guard rails?

mira: add eval guard: must pass MMLU within -3% and Lambada ppl <= +8% vs fp16 for canary to prod. auto-fallback to fp16 model variant on regression.

sam: can you paste the quick run command?

mira: sure — simplified:
```
bench-run --model llama-2-13b --quant gptq-4 --act-order --fused-kv --seq 512 --batch 1 --suite mmlu,lambada
```

bench-bot: nightly-sweep scheduled for 03:00 UTC — adding Llama/Mistral/Qwen GPTQ+AWQ targets.

devin: next steps?

mira: 1) push full logs + eval artifacts to the bake repo (PR by EOD)
2) add AWQ baseline for Qwen to our model-catalog entry with notes
3) update dedicate/pool recommendations in the deployment doc
4) schedule a short sync to decide canary thresholds (tomorrow standup).

alexa: thanks — I can follow up on the catalog entry.

sam: will review PR and sanity-check perf numbers.

mira: TL;DR: Mistral best stability under GPTQ-4, Llama-13B acceptable for throughput, Qwen needs AWQ or fp16 for accuracy-sensitive flows. ops/guard-rails posted in PR. :white_check_mark:
